content.short: Privacy Cash enables private transfers of SOL, ETH and USDC.
content.description: Privacy Cash lets users transfer assets without linking sender and recipient on-chain, covering SOL, ETH and USDC. It is deployed on Solana, Base, Ethereum, Binance Chain and Robinhood Chain. Transaction privacy carries real regulatory weight after previous enforcement actions in this category. It remains an unsettled area and not a solved one.
